name: Golilus Vr
summary:
🐒 Golilus VR

Welcome to Golilus VR, the ultimate place to swing, climb, and absolutely wreak havoc in VR with your friends! Explore the Forest, where trees are taller than your patience and every branch is a potential disaster waiting to happen. Or hit the Beach, where you can race your pals, dodge surprise coconuts, or just flail dramatically in the sand. Don’t forget the Shop, where you can buy weird, funny, or completely unnecessary items—because why not?
